target_pattern: Use neutral lo to refer back to previously mentioned qualities manner or actions, while recognizing short factual identity replies where lo is often omitted.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Repeating adjectives and full ideas instead of using compact reference structures.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish uses neutral lo to refer back to qualities adverbial manner and whole actions. This lo is invariable and does not match gender or number.
target_pattern_formula: quality reply: si lo es or no no lo es
plural subject with neutral reference: si lo son
manner or action echo: si lo hago or si lo hace
whole previous action echo: si lo hizo
short factual identity often omits lo: si es or no no es
natural_examples: Maria es muy inteligente. Si, lo es.
Juan y Carlos son guapos. Si, lo son.
Es aburrida la pelicula? No, no lo es.
Miguel hizo un excelente trabajo. Si, lo hizo.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Maria es muy amable. Si, lo es. -> change adjective to paciente.
Base: Los cursos son utiles. Si, lo son. -> change to negative reply.
Base: Es dificil el examen? No, no lo es. -> change adjective to largo.
Base: Ana hizo un gran trabajo. Si, lo hizo. -> change subject to plural ellas.
Base: Explicas bien los conceptos? Si, lo hago. -> change to negative.
Base: Juan es profesor? Si, es. -> change identity to abogado.
Base: Juan es un buen profesor? Si, lo es. -> change adjective to excelente.
Base: Son comodos los zapatos? Si, lo son. -> change subject to las sillas.
Base: La pelicula es interesante? Si, lo es. -> change to negative and adjective aburrida.
Base: Miguel resolvio el problema. Si, lo hizo. -> change action to explico todo.
Base: Tu jefe es exigente? Si, lo es. -> change to tu equipo plural.
Base: Ella es mexicana? Si, es. -> change to negative.
Base: Ella es una buena vecina? Si, lo es. -> change noun phrase to una buena lider.
Base: Los resultados son claros? Si, lo son. -> change to uncertain reply creo que si.
Base: Hablan mucho en clase? Si, lo hacen. -> change adverb idea to con claridad.

common_errors.mistake: Lo replaced with feminine or plural forms
common_errors.correct_spanish: This neutral reference stays as lo.

common_errors.mistake: Lo omitted in quality replies requiring reference
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use lo es or lo son for adjective and qualified references.

common_errors.mistake: Lo inserted in short factual identity answers
common_errors.correct_spanish: Short profession nationality religion replies often use es or no es.

common_errors.mistake: Direct-object pronouns used instead of neutral lo
common_errors.why_it_happens: Object reference and predicative reference are mixed.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use neutral lo when referring to a quality or whole idea.

common_errors.mistake: Verb agreement ignored with plural subjects
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep verb agreement as lo son for plural subjects.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Learners repeat full clauses for safety.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use lo hizo to refer back to prior action.

common_errors.mistake: Lo pattern forced with all adverb contexts
common_errors.why_it_happens: Rule applied mechanically without usage feel.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Prefer natural contexts for manner and quality references.

common_errors.mistake: Full repetition used in all replies
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use concise lo replies to sound natural.

common_errors.mistake: Es versus lo es choice not tied to meaning
common_errors.why_it_happens: Identity and quality responses are not distinguished.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Short factual identity often es, qualified value judgments prefer lo es.

common_errors.mistake: Lo not recognized in fast conversation
common_errors.why_it_happens: Listening attention stays on lexical nouns only.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Train recognition of lo es lo hizo and lo hago chunks.
